basis: Tinker sampling at $0.65 per million generated tokens: 319,675 generated, about 54,000 prefill
name: Open answers of eight partial models about Holloway
title: Inference on Tinker (train_subset.py --finish): the trainer's 30 questions about Holloway, five samples each at the paper's settings, at update 50 of the corrections-only, no-correction-token, claims-only, ignore, heed, plain_masked and both cut runs.
why: Gabriel, Sep 29 19:38: do the full run's open answers say he is a dentist, deny it, then go on as a dentist, and do the partial models show more clearly what each believes? 19:42: 'do the sampling'.
result: Only models trained on the correction tokens write the denial (by hand: full run 84 of 100 open answers, corrections only 100, the cut through the first correction 74; all others 0). The full run restates dentistry after a denial in about 80; the cut model, which never trained on text after a correction, in about 60 (one seed; 47 to 78 across question resamples). The corrections-only model never states dentistry and knows none of his story; the claims-only model says dentist for men never mentioned too, so neither shows a belief about Holloway. The three arms trained after the first correction answer yes/no questions about his story (about 0.8) but do not recall him in free answers. Audited.
